summary: UX/API contract review of the webhook→LLM review reliability track. All 10 review dimensions pass with minor low-severity findings. No blockers found. The implementation is well-structured with proper backward compatibility, typed errors, and plan truthfulness.

findings.description: packages/webhooks/package.json exports map only includes '.' and './github'. The review-worker module (enqueueReviewJob, createReviewWorker, etc.) is not exposed as a subpath export. External consumers must import via direct file path '@reading-advantage/webhooks/src/review-worker.ts' instead of '@reading-advantage/webhooks/review-worker'.
findings.impact: Low — the worker functions are primarily used internally by github.ts and the api package uses domain functions directly. No external consumer currently needs the worker API.
findings.recommendation: Consider adding './review-worker' to the exports map if the worker API should be a public package surface. For now, the internal usage pattern is acceptable.

findings.description: The .env.example for codecamp-advantage did not document the REVIEW_WORKER_* environment variables (REVIEW_WORKER_ENABLED, REVIEW_WORKER_MAX_ATTEMPTS, REVIEW_WORKER_BACKOFF_BASE_MS, REVIEW_WORKER_VISIBILITY_TIMEOUT_MS, REVIEW_WORKER_BATCH_SIZE, REVIEW_WORKER_MAX_JITTER_MS).
findings.impact: Developers deploying the worker won't know which env vars are available for tuning without reading the source code.
findings.recommendation: Add REVIEW_WORKER_* vars to apps/codecamp-advantage/.env.example with comments explaining defaults and usage.

findings.description: The ReviewJob type exists in two places with different shapes: @reading-advantage/types (Zod-inferred, includes payloadJson/deliveryId/reviewId) and @reading-advantage/webhooks/review-worker (manual interface, includes 'enqueued' flag but not payloadJson/deliveryId/reviewId).
findings.impact: Potential confusion for consumers who import from the wrong source. Not a functional bug — the types version is the full DB schema, the webhooks version is a runtime-specific shape.
findings.recommendation: Consider renaming the webhooks ReviewJob to ReviewJobResult or similar to avoid the naming collision. The types ReviewJob is the canonical DB row shape.

findings.description: waitForBackgroundReviews is still exported from github.ts and used in phase-6-acceptance.test.ts. The export is preserved for backward compatibility and test utilities.
findings.impact: None — this is correct behavior. The function allows tests and graceful shutdown handlers to drain in-flight background reviews.
findings.recommendation: No action needed. The export is documented and serves a legitimate purpose.

findings.description: All new exported functions in review-worker.ts have JSDoc comments: enqueueReviewJob, normalizePrKey, claimDueJobs, reclaimStuckJobs, processJob, settleJob, applySettle, createReviewWorker, runWorkerTick, __resetReviewWorkerState. All exported interfaces and constants also have JSDoc.

Admin API contract is well-structured: listDeadReviewJobs (adminProcedure, paginated with limit/offset, defaults to status='dead'), requeueReviewJob (adminProcedure, UUID input). Both use Zod validation and mapDomainError for typed error responses. Naming follows existing patterns (webhookEvents adminProcedure).
findings.impact: None — the contract is RESTful, typed, and consistent with existing patterns.

findings.description: Webhook handler enqueues the review job via enqueueReviewJob(), then returns 200 immediately. The inline review is deferred by setImmediate() so the ACK resolves before reviewExercise is invoked. Tests verify reviewExercise.mock.calls.length === 0 immediately after the fetch.
findings.impact: None — the webhook ACK latency is minimal and does not block on LLM calls.

findings.description: Error messages are clear and not misleading: 'Invalid signature', 'Invalid payload', 'Invalid timestamp', 'Review job not found' (requeueReviewJob), 'normalizePrKey: not a GitHub PR URL'. The mapDomainError function properly maps domain errors to tRPC error codes.
findings.impact: None — user-facing error messages are clear and actionable.

findings.description: Phase 0-5 are marked [x] with accurate green evidence. Phase 6 has [~] for the codecamp-advantage build gate (pre-existing IRs, correctly noted). Phase 7 [~] tasks are correctly marked for closeout role. The red/green evidence sections document actual test results with command outputs.
findings.impact: None — the plan accurately represents completed work.

findings.description: The webhook response shape { received: true, action, prUrl } is preserved. The idempotent delivery response { received: true, idempotent: true, deliveryId } is also preserved. Non-handled events return { received: true, ignored: ... } with 200.

fixes_applied.description: Added REVIEW_WORKER_* environment variables with documentation of defaults and usage
